offering_description.value: AMETEK designs and manufactures precision instruments for industrial plants, laboratories, utilities and aerospace customers. It also makes motion-control systems, electrical interconnects and specialty metal products for equipment manufacturers and provides calibration, repair and overhaul services.

primary_products.value: Process and laboratory measurement instruments; aerospace and defense instruments; power supplies and electrical test equipment; precision motors and motion-control systems; specialty metal products and electrical interconnects

primary_services.value: Instrument calibration; equipment repair and maintenance; aircraft component repair and overhaul

customer_segment.value: B2B: Industrial plant operators, laboratories, utilities, equipment manufacturers, aircraft manufacturers and airlines; B2G: Defense agencies and government research laboratories

end_markets.value: Industrial and process manufacturing; aerospace and defense; energy and utilities; scientific research; life sciences and medical equipment

revenue_model.value: product sales: Instruments, equipment, engineered components and replacement parts; service fees: Calibration, maintenance, repair and aircraft component overhaul

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds instruments and test systems from sensors, electronics and mechanical parts for industrial and laboratory users; component supplier: Turns metals and electrical parts into motion systems, interconnects and specialty metal products for equipment manufacturers; service provider: Calibrates and repairs instruments and overhauls aircraft components for equipment operators
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; service provider

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Asia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Precision measurement, electrical testing, aerospace systems, motion control, interconnects and specialty metals

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Business-unit sales teams serving industrial accounts, laboratories and equipment manufacturers; distributors / dealers: Independent technical distributors and manufacturer representatives

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Industrial safety and environmental rules, defense export controls and FAA approvals for aircraft component repair operations
